## Hi there! 

I'm **Mai Anh**, a graduate student at **Baruch College**, currently pursuing MS in Business Analytics. I'm working toward a career in **marketing and luxury fashion**, with a growing interest in data-driven decision making, business analytics, and storytelling through data.

This site hosts my coursework and mini-projects for STA 9750, where I'll be building out data analysis skills using R, GitHub, and Quarto over the course of the semester.

Outside of the classroom, I'm passionate about branding, content creation, and independent entrepreneurship.

Feel free to connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maianhtran008/)
